name: us1-markdown-rendering
description: 016 US1/US2 — a specification whose prose exercises every worked example in contracts/markdown-subset.md Part E (bold, code, links, emphasis, strikethrough, escapes, autolinks, images, raw HTML) plus a bullet list, an ordered list, a fenced code block and a table row. Both ports must render byte-identical ADF, exit code, and Jira API call sequence (NFR-1).
